rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Alan Tew
rows.Origin:
Bred by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (before 2003).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2003 as 'Alan Tew'.
Introduced in United States by Ludwig's Roses Phoenix in 2016 as 'Bushveld'.
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Moderate fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Dedicated to Alan Tew (1922 - March 5, 2016 Knysna), South African rosarian, W.F.R.S. Vice-President (Africa – South Africa)
